short.en: The first official MCP Server plugin for GLPI. Exposes GLPI as an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server so AI assistants like Claude and Microsoft Copilot can work with tickets, the knowledge base, the service catalog, projects, and users/groups conversationally.

long.en:
**MCP Server** is the first official MCP Server plugin for GLPI, connecting GLPI to AI assistants over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), letting tools like Claude and Microsoft Copilot work with GLPI conversationally.
### Capabilities - Search, review, and update tickets in plain language, with full history, follow-ups, tasks, solutions, and approvals - Manage ticket actors: add or remove requesters and observers, assign technicians and groups by name - ITIL category tooling: search categories and validate that a ticket's type and category are consistent - Query the knowledge base and complete service catalog forms in natural language - User and group management - Administration: entity listing and details, plus session context - Project tracking with cost visibility
### Access control Tool access follows GLPI's existing profiles: Standard and Central profiles get the full toolset, while Self-Service and Helpdesk profiles are limited to their own tickets and FAQ resources.
### Platform support Works on GLPI Cloud and on-premise instances alike (GLPI 11.0.0–11.9.99). Built with Twig templating, avoids direct SQL queries, and every endpoint enforces permission validation.
### Access MCP Server is distributed under an annual subscription. Request access and see current pricing at the homepage link above.
